notes: Read the full foreign-policy unit, preceding domestic-policy context, all twenty candidates and the review. Resolved every U.S. department, war, base, federal-agent, immigration, citizenship and visa referent; expanded ICE; removed the unsupported heading-only position on all blockades, embargoes and sanctions; and restored support for veterans and the principle that people worldwide deserve lives without U.S. interference.

claims.claim_text: Defund the U.S. Department of War.
Support veterans as well as fully employing them.
People worldwide deserve to live without U.S. interference.
Abolish U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
End U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention and deportations.
Punish brutality by U.S. federal agents.
Legalize migration to the United States.
Grant amnesty to all U.S. immigrants regardless of status.
Provide a path to U.S. citizenship for all permanent residents.
End U.S. visa caps and quotas.
